entries.title: Psalms 92:1
segments: . A Psalm-song--(see on

, title). The theme: God should be praised for His righteous judgments on the wicked and His care and defense of His people. Such a topic, at all times proper, is specially so for the reflections of the Sabbath day. 
 
    1. sing ... name--celebrate Thy perfections.

entries.title: Psalms 92:2
segments: 2. in the morning, ... every night--diligently and constantly (

entries.title: Psalms 92:3
segments:
3. In such a work all proper aid must be used. 
 
    with a ... sound--or, on Higgaion (see on
), perhaps an instrument of that name, from its sound resembling the muttered sound of meditation, as expressed also by the word. This is joined with the harp.

entries.title: Psalms 92:4
segments: 4. thy work--that is of providence (

entries.title: Psalms 92:5
segments: 5. great ... works--correspond to deep or vast thoughts (

entries.title: Psalms 92:6
segments: 6. A brutish man knoweth not--that is, God's works, so the Psalmist describes himself (
) when amazed by the prosperity of the wicked, now understood and explained.

entries.title: Psalms 92:8
segments:
8. This he does in part, by contrasting their ruin with God's exaltation and eternity. 
 
    most high--as occupying the highest place in heaven (

entries.title: Psalms 92:9
segments: 9, 10. A further contrast with the wicked, in the lot of the righteous, safety and triumph.

entries.title: Psalms 92:10
segments: 10. horn ... exalt--is to increase power (
) a figure for refreshment (compare
). Such use of oil is still common in the East.

entries.title: Psalms 92:11
segments: 11. see ... [and] ... hear my desire--or, literally, "look on" my enemies and hear of the wicked (compare
) --that is, I shall be gratified by their fall.

entries.title: Psalms 92:12
segments: 12-14. The vigorous growth, longevity, utility, fragrance, and beauty of these noble trees, set forth the life, character, and destiny of the pious;

entries.title: Psalms 92:15
segments: 15. and they thus declare God's glory as their strong and righteous ruler.
